summary.implementedScope: Fixed the two verifier-blocking Story 2 issues by wiring live PI extension events into the capture service, adding the project-local extension entrypoint, routing relevant session and turn lifecycle events into runtime-note capture, and expanding tests so production handler registration proves live `message_end`, duplicate suppression, and runtime-note behavior while preserving existing AC-2.2 and AC-2.4 coverage.

changedFiles.reason: Registers real PI handlers for `session_start`, `session_before_switch`, `session_shutdown`, `turn_start`, `turn_end`, and `message_end`; initializes the managed thread and routes live finalized messages/runtime notes into capture-service.
Adds the project-local PI extension entrypoint that delegates to the production context steward extension implementation.
Adds production-handler tests for live prompt/response/tool-result capture, duplicate suppression, and session/turn runtime-note capture through registered PI handlers.
Adds reusable PI extension context fixture support for production extension tests.
Provides Story 2 canonical capture orchestration used by the newly wired production extension path.
Provides finalized PI message and runtime-note mapping used by the production extension path.
